title: Methodist Church after the basement was built
description: This photo shows the interior of the Methodist Church, which later became part of the United Church of Canada, decorated for Thanksgiving. It was taken after 1913, when the church was lifted to add a basement with concrete walls and floor, allowing for the installation of a furnace and the construction of classrooms.
